schema:name: NMRA Case Management Back End
schema:description: Back-end regulatory information system used by the National Medicines Regulatory Authority to receive, store, triage, assign, track, and manage substandard and falsified medical product reports, initiate feedback to reporters, and exchange data with national registries and global surveillance systems.
